injection.refusal: I can't go there — could you put that another way?
llm.apology_retry: Sorry, that answer came out wrong. Let me put it differently.
api.kb_disabled: The knowledge base is not enabled
api.doc_id_invalid: doc_id may contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens
api.content_empty: Nothing to store: the content was empty
api.write_failed: Write failed; the file was left unchanged.
api.trace_not_found: trace is no longer in the buffer (later messages may have pushed it out)
pipeline.note: The order is the security model, so the panel offers no way to change it; the sandbox reordering is a teaching aid only
pipeline.constraint.guard.whitelist: Authorisation must precede the allow-list check, or a blocklist entry could skip identity verification
pipeline.constraint.wake.strip_wake: Decide whether the bot was addressed before stripping the wake word; reversed, "hey bot hello" becomes "hello"
pipeline.constraint.strip_wake.sanitize: Sanitising must act on the text after the wake word is removed, or zero-width characters inside it slip past the check
pipeline.constraint.sanitize.injection_s: Normalise before screening for injection; reversed, zero-width characters defeat the keyword match
pipeline.constraint.injection_screen.com: Injection screening must precede command execution
pipeline.constraint.authorization.comman: The caller's role must be established before a command runs
pipeline.constraint.command.persist: Command messages are not persisted, or they would pollute the context
pipeline.constraint.persist.model: The history the model sees must already contain the current message
pipeline.constraint.safety.reply: The safety check must precede sending, or it cannot stop a reply that already went out
